scope: All current Godot runtime visual object archetypes; repeated placement instances grouped; distinct authored mesh nodes preserved in variant_coverage. UI-only inventory items and unused historical assets excluded.
direction_convention: Godot front -Z, back +Z, left -X, right +X, top +Y, bottom -Y

entries.title: 무덤길 방랑자
entries.description_en: A weary hooded medieval human wanderer wearing filthy brown layered wool and leather, ragged cloak, practical worn boots, realistic dark fantasy survivor.

entries.title: 성소 감시자

entries.title: 굶주린 납골당지기

entries.title: 상자 조작 손과 소매

notes: Individual gameplay inventory consumables exist as 2D icons; they have no runtime 3D representation unless listed as cooking ingredients.
Healing light is a HUD pulse without a distinct world mesh.

Variations can be rendered via build_object(id, variant_index).
